sloka: न इयम् अन्येन नगरी शक्या धर्षयितुम् बलात् ।रक्षिता रावण बलैः उद्यत आयुध धारिभिः ॥५-३-१४॥
transliteration: na iyam anyena nagarī śakyā dharṣayitum balāt ।rakṣitā rāvaṇa balaiḥ udyata āyudha dhāribhiḥ ॥5-3-14॥

translations.english: 'It is not possible to attack this city by to outsiders as it is protected by the forces of Ravana with their weapons ready(to attack).
